acceptance: Tree output for a join shows its conditions, truncated sensibly for long expressions.
A test with a real captured DuckDB or SQLite join plan asserts the condition text appears.
Existing tree tests and MCP tree output stay correct.
context:
Noted while moving MCP rendering to the canonical renderer (PR #3708).

Guardrails: change rendering only, never plan data or fingerprints. Reuse the existing detail-line pattern in visualization.py; cap each condition (about 120 chars) and the number shown per node so huge plans stay readable. Smoke: benchbox show-plan on a real TPC-H Q3 DuckDB bundle and the MCP tree for the same plan.

Verification rubric: (1) a regression test or reproduction fails before and passes after; (2) focused suites pass via uv run -- python -m pytest -n 0; (3) make comment-policy-check and ruff on touched files pass; (4) the runtime smoke named in acceptance is recorded in the PR body; (5) the PR merges with green CI and a passing oracle review.
description: render_plan (benchbox/core/query_plans/visualization.py) prints Join nodes as `Join (type=inner)` without their join_conditions, although the canonical plan stores them and they are part of the fingerprint. benchbox show-plan and the MCP get_query_plan tree format both use it, so a reader cannot see why two joins differ.
